units.mb: MiB (2^20 bytes) of resident gateway heap per tenant
units.knob_mb: MiB of completion bytes (the live knob's accounting)

lmsys_response_agreement.protocol: 100k reservoir (prompt, response) pairs, all user turns, raw text, insert first half, query second half, unbounded cache; correct if response cosine >= 0.70

notes: QQP pairs were sampled to be topically related (about 37% are duplicates), so its precision is not the precision of a cache's hits; it bounds how often a pair at a given cosine is a true paraphrase.
The LMSYS proxy counts a hit wrong when responses disagree, including stylistic disagreement between models; it is a pessimistic bound (CACHE_PRECISION.md).

plant2.unit: MiB of resident gateway heap per tenant
